# SkillLinkr

SkillLinkr is a student collaboration platform designed to help college students find teammates for projects, hackathons, startups, and research.

## Features
- Smart Discover: Find students by skills, domain, college, and academic year.
- Team Formation: Build balanced teams for hackathons and academic projects.
- Room/Section Swap: Mutually match with other students to swap hostel rooms or academic sections.

## Technologies Used
- Next.js App Router
- React
- Tailwind CSS

## Website Sections
- Homepage: https://www.skilllinkr.com
- Blog: https://www.skilllinkr.com/blog
- Features: https://www.skilllinkr.com/features/smart-discover
- Explore Domains: https://www.skilllinkr.com/domains/artificial-intelligence
- Explore Skills: https://www.skilllinkr.com/skills/react

## Mission
To be the ultimate network for actionable student collaboration across universities.
